edits.value_json: The traditional explanation combines 夕, evening, with 口, associated with speaking one’s name when people cannot see one another. This is a received account, not an established explanation of the graph’s original motivation.

The received analysis is semantic: 夕 sets an evening scene and 口 contributes the idea of speaking one’s name. A secondary proposal treats 夕 as a sound indicator, but the cited material does not establish that role; the graph’s original motivation remains uncertain.

夕 is the upper element in the historical forms described by the cited accounts. Its basic sense is the time around sunset and moonrise, sometimes extending to night; in the received explanation of 名, it supplies the evening setting.

口 is the lower element in the historical forms described by the cited accounts. In the received explanation, it contributes the idea of speaking one’s name; the cited accounts do not describe a separate graphic history for it within this character.

名 means “name” or “to name.” The traditional explanation combines 夕, evening, with 口, associated with speaking one’s name when people cannot see one another; this account of the graph’s original motivation is unverified.
In the historical account, 夕 is the upper element and supplies the evening setting.
In the historical account, 口 is the lower element and contributes the idea of speaking a name.
